candidate_evidence.quote: This is a phase 0/1 dose-escalation trial to determine the maximum tolerated dose of Mycophenolate Mofetil (MMF) when administered with radiation, in patients with glioblastoma or gliosarcoma.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma or gliosarcoma (recurrent or newly diagnosed).

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Concentrations of Guanosine Triphosphate (GTP) in Tumor Tissue in Phase 0 Participants: The concentrations of GTP in tumor tissue, measured by mass spectrometry on a continuous scale.

role_evidence.quote: Phase 1 - Recurrent GBM / GS: Mycophenolate mofetil; radiation therapy
250-2000mg orally twice daily, one week prior to and concurrent with RT and cyclic chemotherapy with temozolomide.

agents.drug_class_hint: immunosuppressant (IMPDH inhibitor); mycophenolate mofetil is the morpholinoethyl ester prodrug of mycophenolic acid

role_evidence.quote: The dosing and timing of temozolomide therapy will be determined as per standard-of-care for the individual patient by the treating oncologist.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care

source_quote.quote: Concentrations of Guanosine Triphosphate (GTP) in Tumor Tissue in Phase 0 Participants

coder_notes: Mycophenolate mofetil mapped to parent mycophenolic acid per ester-to-parent rule (record also measures MPA as active metabolite). Temozolomide is SOC backbone only in the newly diagnosed phase 1 arm. 'Astrocytoma, Grade IV' without IDH requirement -> historical terminology. Tumour GTP is a pharmacodynamic marker, not a selection biomarker. Registered phase PHASE1 though titled phase 0/I.
